notes.title: Patch Notes for 2025-03-07
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Made targeting more sticky by only switching during manual mode..
[*] Moved hero swapping to D-Pad Up in game and triggers in menus.
[*] Fixed Main Menu camera.
[*] Added dodge counters: A special attack is played after dodging and pressing the regular attack button.
[*] Added strong attack when you tap the charge button.
[*] Added guard counters: tap the charge button after blocking and you play a special attack that does massive stance damage.
[*] Removed parrying from the game.
[*] Stamina impacts more parts of the game: reduces when blocking an attack, sprinting and dodging. Recharged when not in an action.
[*] New target indicators that are on the character's chest instead of over top of them.
[*] Added health bars to the top of all characters during combat.
[*] Added stamina and favour UI to local players (and removed the character portraits).
[/list]

tags.balance_change: - Made targeting more sticky by only switching during manual mode..
- Moved hero swapping to D-Pad Up in game and triggers in menus.

- Added strong attack when you tap the charge button.
- Added guard counters: tap the charge button after blocking and you play a special attack that does massive stance damage.

notes.title: Patch Notes for 2025-02-19
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Successful parries only stop physical damage (not stance damage).
[*] Add many video settings to support lower end machines.
[*] Don’t bring up Solo Choice in the interaction tutorial if your character doesn’t have the skill.
[*] Main Menu level art layout featuring characters.
[*] Moving all menu navigation to Left Stick / DPad (Gamepad) and Arrows (Keyboard).
[*] Ranged attacks can be buffered / interrupted.
[/list]
